parameters.name: property_visibility

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: The property filter. Expand to view all attributes associated with this filter. If required, you must submit an id for at least one of the below filters.

parameters.name: created_by
parameters.description: Created by id to filter by.

parameters.name: gl_account_ids
parameters.description: The gl account ids to filter by.

parameters.description: The 'Date From' date to filter by.

parameters.name: posted_on_to
parameters.description: The 'Date To' date to filter by.

parameters.name: updated_at_from
parameters.description: The 'Last Edited From' date to filter by.

parameters.name: updated_at_to
parameters.description: The 'Last Edited To' date to filter by.

parameters.name: accounting_basis
parameters.description: The accounting basis to filter by.

parameters.name: reverse_transaction
parameters.description: Whether or not to Show Reversed Transactions

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Returns the specified columns. All columns are returned by default. Look at the response schema to see the available columns.
